verdict.rationale: mise's dependencies are the tools declared in mise.toml. `mise use` installs a tool and records it in config (mise-docs-2, mise-docs-16, mise-docs-31), unlike `mise exec`, which explicitly does not touch project configuration (mise-docs-66). A committed lockfile exists (mise-docs-70), and `mise lock --bump --dry-run --json` gives an agent a machine-readable, previewable way to bump locked versions (mise-docs-35). missing for 10: any documented CLI command for removing a tool from the manifest, explicit evidence that `mise use` also rewrites the lockfile, a documented upgrade command that updates both manifest and lockfile together, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
